svg.title: Dipole and two ideal radiators
svg.desc: Normalised patterns of short and half-wave dipoles, and of two ideal isotropic sources with half-wavelength spacing and two feed phases.

cc:Work.dc:title: Dipole and two ideal radiators
cc:Work.dc:description: Normalised dipole and array power patterns for two isotropic sources at half-wavelength spacing and two relative phases.
